strings.name: effect_360reorientsphere_desc
strings.value: Reorients a 360º photo or video in equirectangular format.This effect interprets the layer as an equirectangular photo or video, projects it onto a sphere, rotates the sphere, and then projects the sphere back into equirectangular format. The result is as if the original camera that recorded the 360º image or video had been positioned at a different angle.

strings.name: effect_360viewer_desc
strings.value: Projects a 360º photo or video onto a flat surface, as if viewed from within the 360º sphere.

strings.name: effect_advanced_chroma_key_desc
strings.value: "Keys out pixels based on how closely they match or don't match a group of colors, making the keyed out parts of the layer transparent. This is similar to the Chroma Key effect but offers more precise control and more color options. Useful for greenscreening or bluescreening."

strings.name: effect_bend_desc
strings.value: Bends the layer along a circular arc.

strings.name: effect_blink_desc
strings.value: Automatically adjusts the opacity of the layer, alternating between its normal value and zero over time.

strings.name: effect_blocknoise_desc
strings.value: Multiplies randomly generated rectangular blocks of noise with the existing colors of opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_box_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D box using the layer as a surface texture.

strings.name: effect_boxblur3_tip
strings.value: For a smoother blur, try Gaussian Blur.

strings.name: effect_boxblur_desc
strings.value: Blurs the layer by averaging the colors of nearby pixels in a surrounding rectangular area (hence box blur).

strings.name: effect_boxblur_tip
strings.value: More iterations give better quality, but slower preview performance. We recommend 2 iterations.

strings.name: effect_brightnessContrast_desc
strings.value: Adjusts the brightness or contrast of the layer.

strings.name: effect_bumpmap_desc
strings.value: Uses a height map to model bumps or perturbations in the surface of the layer, then applies simulated lighting and shading.

strings.name: effect_channelmap_desc
strings.value: Remaps the red, green, blue, and alpha channels in the layer.

strings.name: effect_channelmaphsv_desc
strings.value: Remaps the hue, saturation, value, and alpha channels in the layer.

strings.name: effect_channelshift_desc
strings.value: Splits the red, green and blue channels of the layer, keeping one fixed in position and shifting the other two channels in opposite directions.

strings.name: effect_checker_desc
strings.value: Renders a checkerboard pattern in the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_checkerdissolve_desc
strings.value: Randomly removes grid-aligned rectangular pieces from the layer by making them transparent. Keyframe animation can be applied to remove progressively more and more rectangles over time.

strings.name: effect_chromakey_desc
strings.value: Keys out all pixels similar to a particular color, making those parts of the layer transparent. Useful for greenscreening or bluescreening.

strings.name: effect_chromatic_zoomblur_desc
strings.value: Applies a radial blur to the layer resulting in a zoom-in and zoom-out effect, dynamically adjusting the strength of the blur for each color channel.

strings.name: effect_circularripple_desc
strings.value: Distorts the layer in a pattern concentric circles around a center point, similar to the ripples caused by a pebble dropped in water.

strings.name: effect_clouds_desc
strings.value: Renders a procedurally generated cloud pattern in the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_color_balance_desc
strings.value: Makes targeted adjustments to the Red, Green, and Blue channels based on shadows, midtones, and highlights.

strings.name: effect_colorize_desc
strings.value: Changes the color of the layer, keeping the original luminance.

strings.name: effect_colortemperature_desc
strings.value: Corrects a photo or video so it appears as if illuminated by a light source with a different color temperature. Useful for changing the mood of a scene or correcting for the wrong illumination or white balance.

strings.name: effect_colortune_desc
strings.value: Smoothly tune the color of dark and light parts of a photo or video segmented by lift, gamma, and gain. Use this to achieve various color looks, to change the mood of the video, or to match the color of different takes.

strings.name: effect_contour_strips_desc
strings.value: Renders strips of thin paper-like material, layered front to back, using the layer luminance or opacity as a height map for each strip.

strings.name: effect_contourgrad_desc
strings.value: Renders a gradient around the contours of the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_contourlines_desc
strings.value: Draws one or more lines around the contours of the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_copybg_desc
strings.value: Copies the background into the layer, effectively turning the layer into an adjustment layer. Effects applied to the layer after this will apply to the background pixels covered by the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_copybg_tip
strings.value: This effect copies the pixels behind this layer into the current layer. Use this together with other effects to apply them to the background. For example, to use Box Blur after applying Copy Background to blur the background.

strings.name: effect_counter_desc
strings.value: Replaces existing numbers in a text layer with the same number added to or multiplied with a fixed value. Useful for creating animations that count up or down.

strings.name: effect_cube_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D cube using the layer as a surface texture.

strings.name: effect_curl_desc
strings.value: Deforms the layer by curling it into a circular shape from one end.

strings.name: effect_cylinder_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D cylinder using the layer as a surface texture.

strings.name: effect_dark_glow_desc
strings.value: Creates dark blooms around darker areas within a photo or video layer based on a luminance threshold.

strings.name: effect_dblur_desc
strings.value: Blurs the layer by averaging nearby pixel colors along a specified angle, similar to the blur caused by motion in a fixed direction.

strings.name: effect_displacemap_desc
strings.value: Displaces pixels in the background based on the color of pixels in the layer.

strings.name: effect_displacemaprad_desc
strings.value: Angularly displaces pixels in the background based on the color of pixels in the layer.

strings.name: effect_dissolve_desc
strings.value: Randomly removes pixels in the layer. This effect can be animated to create a pixel dissolve transition.

strings.name: effect_dots_desc
strings.value: Draws a pattern of random dots in the opaque parts of the layer. Each dot is placed randomly, but the randomness is controlled so that the overall distribution of dots when taken together is approximately uniform.

strings.name: effect_drawingprogress_desc
strings.value: Clips the beginning and end of the vector outline of the layer so that the outline is only partially drawn.

strings.name: effect_echo_keyframes_desc
strings.value: Creates one or more copies or echoes of the layer as it appeared or will appear at different points in time, based only on keyframe animation applied to the layer.

strings.name: effect_edge_glow_desc
strings.value: Detects edges in a photo or video and creates a glow around them.

strings.name: effect_electric_edges_desc
strings.value: Creates a glowing energy-like outline and optional contour lines around the opaque parts of the layer, which can be animated to look like arcs of electricity.

strings.name: effect_ellipsoid_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D ellipsoid using the layer as a surface texture.

strings.name: effect_energy_beam_desc
strings.value: Renders a beam of energy between two points within the layer.

strings.name: effect_exposure_desc
strings.value: Adjusts the exposure, gamma curve, and luminance offset of photo and video layers.

strings.name: effect_fade_desc
strings.value: Automatically animates the layer opacity to fade the layer in at its beginning, and out again at its end.

strings.name: effect_fastboxblur_tip
strings.value: More iterations give better quality, but slower preview performance. We recommend 3 iterations.

strings.name: effect_favorite_add_msg
strings.value: Tap *** next to any effect to add it to your favorites.

strings.name: effect_feather_desc
strings.value: Softens the edges of the opaque part of the layer by blurring the alpha channel.

strings.name: effect_fill_behind_desc
strings.value: Fills the area behind the layer with a modified copy of the layer, with optional adjustments such as blur, saturation, tint, and brightness, providing a convenient way to quickly adapt a photo or video for use in a project with a different aspect ratio or orientation.

strings.name: effect_findedges_desc
strings.value: Finds edges in a photo or video layer by detecting sharp changes in luminance between nearby pixels.

strings.name: effect_flicker_desc
strings.value: Randomly flickers the layer by automatically adjusting the opacity over time.

strings.name: effect_flip2_desc
strings.value: Flips the layer in 3D along a specified axis.

strings.name: effect_fourcolorgradient_desc
strings.value: Overlays the opaque parts of the layer with a gradient made between four individually positioned colors.

strings.name: effect_fractwarp_desc
strings.value: Distorts the layer using a procedurally generated fractal pattern. Useful for simulating distortions caused by real-world phenomena such as fire, water, and heat.

strings.name: effect_gaussianblur_desc
strings.value: Applies a fast, smooth blur to the layer using a gaussian function, reducing noise and details in the layer.

strings.name: effect_glass_desc
strings.value: Renders the layer as if the opaque parts were made of beveled glass, refracting the background and overlaying specular highlights.

strings.name: effect_glow_desc
strings.value: Draws a glow around the outside of the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_glowinner_desc
strings.value: Draws a glow along the inside edges of the opaque parts the layer.

strings.name: effect_glowscan_desc
strings.value: Renders a blur combined with a smooth glow within a region of the layer defined by a luminance band.

strings.name: effect_gradientmap_desc
strings.value: Maps colors in the layer onto a gradient based on their lightness.

strings.name: effect_gradientoverlay_desc
strings.value: Overlays the opaque parts of the layer with a gradient.

strings.name: effect_grid_desc
strings.value: Overlays the opaque parts of the layer with grid lines.

strings.name: effect_grunge_desc
strings.value: Builds up multiple layers of simulated grunge, grime, spots, specks, stains and blemishes within the center and inner edges of the layer based on preset textures or grains, creating an aged, worn, or textured look to the layer.

strings.name: effect_halftonedots_desc
strings.value: Replaces continuous tones in the layer with a pattern of monochrome dots of varying sizes, similar to the process used in newspaper or comic book printing.

strings.name: effect_halftonedotscmyk_desc
strings.value: Replaces continuous tones in the layer with a pattern of dots of varying sizes for each CMYK color channel, similar to the process used in magazine or comic book printing.

strings.name: effect_halftonelines_desc
strings.value: Replaces continuous tones in the layer with a pattern of monochrome lines of varying thickness, a variation of the process used in newspaper or comic book printing.

strings.name: effect_heart_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D heart using the layer as a surface texture.

strings.name: effect_hexarray_desc
strings.value: Covers opaque parts of the layer in an array of hexagons.

strings.name: effect_hexprism_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D hexagonal prism using the layer as a surface texture.

strings.name: effect_hexrotate_desc
strings.value: Divides the layer into a grid of hexagonal tiles and rotates the pixels in each tile independently.

strings.name: effect_hexshift_desc
strings.value: Divides the layer into a grid of hexagonal tiles and shifts the contents of each tile in a random direction.

strings.name: effect_hextile_desc
strings.value: Repeats the layer in a pattern of hexagonal tiles, filling the screen.

strings.name: effect_highlightShadow_desc
strings.value: Independently adjusts the intensity of the lightest and darkest parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_hollow_box_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D hollow box, using the layer as a surface texture, with sides that can be turned on or off, punched out with preset shapes, or offset outward.

strings.name: effect_hotcolor_desc
strings.value: Remaps a grayscale image (or luminance values of a color image) into an intense color ramp based on two selected hues.

strings.name: effect_hueshift_desc
strings.value: Rotates the color hues in the layer.

strings.name: effect_innerblur_desc
strings.value: Blurs the opaque parts of the layer without blurring the opacity.

strings.name: effect_invert_desc
strings.value: "Inverts the layer's red, green, or blue channels independently."

strings.name: effect_irrid_desc
strings.value: Renders a flowing iridescent pattern in opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_jitter_desc
strings.value: Automatically jumps the layer randomly back and forth over time, along a selected angle.

strings.name: effect_kaleidoscope_desc
strings.value: Creates symmetric radial reflections of the layer.

strings.name: effect_key_spill_cleaner_desc
strings.value: Cleans up greenscreen or bluescreen spill near the edges of a layer, such as the green fringe left over after applying a matte effect such a Chroma Key, by isolating a feathered region around the inside of the edges of the layer and propagating interior hue and saturation outward into the isolated region while maintaining the original luminance.

strings.name: effect_lensblur_desc
strings.value: Applies an angular blur to the layer, excluding the central area.

strings.name: effect_lensflare_desc
strings.value: Renders a lens flare in the layer.

strings.name: effect_light_glow_desc
strings.value: Creates a soft glow and optional halo around the lighter areas within a photo or video layer based on a luminance threshold.

strings.name: effect_lightning_desc
strings.value: Renders fractal arcs of lightning between two points in the layer.

strings.name: effect_linearstreaks_desc
strings.value: Creates line-shaped streaks by sliding the layer at an angle and blending together overlapping pixels.

strings.name: effect_longshadow_desc
strings.value: Renders long parallel shadows extending from opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_luma_stamper_desc
strings.value: Extracts a mask from the layer based on the brightness of pixels in the layer, optionally clipping out noise in the extreme light and dark areas of the layer, then uses the mask to stamp a solid color into the project.

strings.name: effect_lumakey_desc
strings.value: Keys out all pixels lighter than or darker than a given threshold, making those parts of the layer transparent.

strings.name: effect_magnify_background_desc
strings.value: Makes the layer transparent and magnifies the area behind the layer, as if the layer were a magnifying glass.

strings.name: effect_maskblur_desc
strings.value: Blurs the background behind the layer, with the blur strength based on the layer luminance.

strings.name: effect_mattechoke_desc
strings.value: Expands the transparent parts of the layer, shrinking the opaque parts.

strings.name: effect_mattefringe_desc
strings.value: Isolates a narrow feathered strip around the interior edge of the layer and replaces the hue and saturation in that strip with the hue and saturation behind the layer, keeping the original luminance. Use this after applying a matte or key effect to reduce stray colors in the edge of the matte.

strings.name: effect_mblur_desc
strings.value: "Simulates motion blur by blurring the layer based on position, rotation, and scale keyframe animation from the layer's Move & Transform settings, as well as motion from certain other effects that are compatible with motion blur."

strings.name: effect_mblur_tip
strings.value: To use: Animate the layer using Move & Transform (blur will be applied automatically).

strings.name: effect_mirror_desc
strings.value: Overlays the layer with a copy of itself mirrored along either the horizontal or vertical axis, with optional alpha and blending mode control.

strings.name: effect_mosaic_desc
strings.value: Divides the layer into array of squares and averages the color of each square, resulting in a pixelated look.

strings.name: effect_movealongpath_desc
strings.value: Positions the layer at a point partway way along the outline path of the layer immediately beneath.

strings.name: effect_noise_desc
strings.value: Blends random noise with the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_octahedron_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D regular octahedron using the layer as a surface texture.

strings.name: effect_offset_desc
strings.value: Offsets the layer content, wrapping at the edges of the bounding box of the layer.

strings.name: effect_omino_diffusion_desc
strings.value: Renders a photo or video layer with a limited palette using error diffusion, but damping or exaggerating the quantization errors to create intentional distortions. Individual images become unrecognizable, but action can be seen in the moving aggregate. This effect is based on the Omino Suite, with special thanks to David Van Brink.

strings.name: effect_omino_glass_desc
strings.value: Renders the layer as though it were made of glass, with refraction and a glossy contour, and chromatic aberration based on segmentation of the visible spectrum into seven regions. The layer luminance may optionally be used as a height map. This effect is based on the Omino Suite, with special thanks to David Van Brink.

strings.name: effect_oscillate_desc
strings.value: Moves the layer back and forth repeatedly.

strings.name: effect_page_curl_desc
strings.value: Curls a corner of the layer upwards as if the layer were made of paper or thin plastic.

strings.name: effect_palettemap_desc
strings.value: Maps pixel colors in the layer to the closest matching color in a palette.

strings.name: effect_parenthelper_desc
strings.value: "Adjusts how the layer's scale and rotation react to changes in the parent's scale and rotation."

strings.name: effect_parenthelper_tip
strings.value: To use: Parent this layer to another using Layer Parenting (this effect shoud be applied to a child layer)

strings.name: effect_pinchbulge_desc
strings.value: Distorts the layer by pinching it towards the center or expanding it outward.

strings.name: effect_pinchbulgeinside_desc
strings.value: Distorts the layer by pinching it towards the center or expanding it outwards, without affecting the edges or opacity of the layer.

strings.name: effect_pixelate_desc
strings.value: Decreases the layer resolution so that individual pixels become visible, sampling at the centers of the pixels, and drawing each pixel with an optional vignette.

strings.name: effect_plus_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D three-axis cross using the layer as a surface texture.

strings.name: effect_polar_desc
strings.value: Warps the layer by mapping from cartesian coordinates to polar coordinates.

strings.name: effect_posterize_desc
strings.value: "Decreases the number of step in the layer's color channels."

strings.name: effect_preciseboxblur_desc
strings.value: Performs a slow but precise box blur of the layer.

strings.name: effect_pulsate_desc
strings.value: Automatically grows and shrinks the layer repeatedly over time, based on a sine wave or triangular wave.

strings.name: effect_pulseopacity_desc
strings.value: Automatically pulses the layer opacity over time, based on a sine wave or triangular wave.

strings.name: effect_pyramid_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D regular pyramid with a square base, using the layer as a surface texture.

strings.name: effect_radialrays_desc
strings.value: Overlays multiple solid-color radial rays in the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_radialshadow_desc
strings.value: Renders long shadows radiating away from a point, based on the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_radialwipe_desc
strings.value: Masks out a region of the layer bounded by two radial lines.

strings.name: effect_raster_extrude_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D raster extrusion of the layer based on the opaque and transparent pixels within the layer, using the opaque parts of the layer as a surface texture for the front and back of the extrusion.

strings.name: effect_raster_transform_desc
strings.value: Scales, rotates, or offsets the layer, much like Move & Transform, but after rasterization and after applying any preceding effects on the layer, allowing the output of effects to be transformed.

strings.name: effect_raymarch_iter_tip
strings.value: Increase precision for better edge quality; decrease for faster preview performance. For best results, an precision between 30 and 60 is recommended.

strings.name: effect_raymarch_tip
strings.value: Use more iterations for better edge quality; use less iterations for faster preview performance. For best results, an iteration count between 30 and 60 is recommended.

strings.name: effect_rays_desc
strings.value: Renders light rays from bright parts of the layer, based on the threshold setting.

strings.name: effect_repeat_desc
strings.value: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer.

strings.name: effect_repeatgrid_desc
strings.value: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer, arranged in a grid.

strings.name: effect_repeatline_desc
strings.value: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer, arranged along a line.

strings.name: effect_repeatpath_desc
strings.value: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer along the outline path of the layer immediately beneath.

strings.name: effect_repeatradial_desc
strings.value: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer, arranged in a circular pattern.

strings.name: effect_repeatscatter_desc
strings.value: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer, scattered randomly around the original layer location.

strings.name: effect_replacecolor_desc
strings.value: Replaces one color in the layer with another.

strings.name: effect_rgb_gamma_desc
strings.value: Adjusts the gamma curve of the red, green, and blue channels independently.

strings.name: effect_rgb_mixer_desc
strings.value: Remixes the red, green and blue channels in the layer.

strings.name: effect_ribbon_desc
strings.value: Renders a twisted, flowing ribbon of varying width in the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_ridges_desc
strings.value: Renders a procedurally generated pattern of turbulent ridges in the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_ring_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D ring with flat faces, using the layer as a surface texture.

strings.name: effect_roughenedges_desc
strings.value: Roughens the edges of the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_scaleassist_desc
strings.value: Applies additional layer scale on top of the scale set in Move & Transform.

strings.name: effect_scatter_field_desc
strings.value: Scatters copies of the layer within an infinite 3D field while hiding the original layer, and allows simulated motion within the field in three dimensions through keyframe animation.

strings.name: effect_shake_desc
strings.value: Moves the layer randomly over time within specified parameters.

strings.name: effect_sharpen_desc
strings.value: Enhances details in the layer by increasing the contrast wherever there are abrupt differences in the luminance of nearby pixels in the layer.

strings.name: effect_simplestars_desc
strings.value: Renders a simple parallax starfield pattern, with a depth component, in the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_simplexdisplace_desc
strings.value: Automatically moves the layer smoothly but randomly over time

strings.name: effect_smooth_edges_desc
strings.value: Smooths the edges of the opaque parts of a layer without affecting the pixel colors within the layer.

strings.name: effect_smoothbevel_desc
strings.value: Draws a smooth curved bevel inside the edges of the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_soft_glow_desc
strings.value: Creates a soft Gaussian-based glow within a photo or video layer, or around the outside edge of any layer.

strings.name: effect_solidcolor_desc
strings.value: Fills the opaque parts of the layer with a solid color.

strings.name: effect_solidmatte_desc
strings.value: Composites the layer on a solid color matte, filling transparent parts of the layer with a solid background color.

strings.name: effect_spectralmap_desc
strings.value: Maps each color in the layer into a custom spectrum of colors based on the brightness of the original color.

strings.name: effect_spherize_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D sphere, interpreting the layer as an equirectangular projection and using it as a surface texture for the sphere.

strings.name: effect_spin_desc
strings.value: Automatically spins the layer at a given speed.

strings.name: effect_spinblur_desc
strings.value: Applies an angular blur to the layer, as though it were spinning.

strings.name: effect_spinstreaks_desc
strings.value: Creates arc-shaped streaks by spinning the layer around a point and blending together overlapping pixels.

strings.name: effect_spotcolor_desc
strings.value: Keeps one color while decreasing the saturation of other colors in the layer.

strings.name: effect_squeeze_desc
strings.value: Distorts the layer by squeezing it along one axis while expanding it along the other axis.

strings.name: effect_star_desc
strings.value: Renders an individual star in the current layer.

strings.name: effect_star_polyhedron_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D star polyhedron using the layer as a surface texture.

strings.name: effect_starfield_desc
strings.value: Renders a complex parallax starfield that can be animated in two dimensions.

strings.name: effect_starprism_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D star prism using the layer as a surface texture.

strings.name: effect_streak_strips_desc
strings.value: Divides the layer into strips of equal size, then stretches the middle row of pixels in each one to fill the entire strip, resulting in streaks of color.

strings.name: effect_stretch_desc
strings.value: Stretches the layer in an arbitrary direction.

strings.name: effect_stretchsegment_desc
strings.value: Slices the layer along an angle and then moves the pieces apart, stretching the pixels between them.

strings.name: effect_stripes_desc
strings.value: Renders a pattern of stripes in the opaque parts of the layer.

strings.name: effect_stroketaper_desc
strings.value: Tapers the strokes of a freehand drawing layer.

strings.name: effect_swing_desc
strings.value: Automatically rotates the layer back and forth over time.

strings.name: effect_swirl_desc
strings.value: Warps the layer by rotating it different amounts based on the distance from a center-point, resulting in a vortex or whirlpool-like distortion.

strings.name: effect_textprogress_desc
strings.value: Partially displays a text layer, character by character.

strings.name: effect_textrandomize_desc
strings.value: Randomly changes individual characters in a text layer.

strings.name: effect_textspacing_desc
strings.value: Adjusts the spacing between individual letters or between lines of text in a text layer.

strings.name: effect_texttransform_desc
strings.value: Transforms individual letters, words, lines, or pieces of letters within a specified range of a text layer.

strings.name: effect_threshold_desc
strings.value: Converts the layer to black and white with a hard cutoff at the specified luminance threshold.

strings.name: effect_tilerotate_desc
strings.value: Divides the layer into a grid of tiles and rotates the pixels in each tile independently.

strings.name: effect_tiles_desc
strings.value: Repeats the layer in a tile pattern, filling the screen.

strings.name: effect_tileshift_desc
strings.value: Divides the layer into a grid of tiles and shifts the contents of each tile in a random direction.

strings.name: effect_timecode_desc
strings.value: Replaces the text in the layer with a running timecode.

strings.name: effect_timequant_desc
strings.value: Causes time to pass in steps, but just for this layer.

strings.name: effect_tip_echokf
strings.value: To use: Animate the layer using keyframe animation with other effects or properties (echoes will be created based on keyframe animation).

strings.name: effect_torus_desc
strings.value: Renders a faux-3D torus using the layer as a surface texture.

strings.name: effect_tunnel_desc
strings.value: Renders a round faux-3D tunnel using the layer as the interior surface texture.

strings.name: effect_turbulence_desc
strings.value: Renders smooth patterns of procedurally-generated fractal noise in the opaque parts of the layer, useful for simulating real-world phenomena like clouds, or for use as a luminance map.

strings.name: effect_turbulentdisplace_desc
strings.value: Distorts the layer along selected coordinate axes using a random pattern of smooth fractal noise. Distortion may be along one or more axis in either cartesian or polar coordinate space. Useful for simulating distortions caused by real-world phenomena such as fire, water, and heat, or for modeling real-world objects that are naturally irregular such as mountains.

strings.name: effect_unsharp_mask_desc
strings.value: Enhances the perceptual sharpness or acutance of a photo or video by increasing local contrast near edges, while avoiding changes to areas that were originally smooth.

strings.name: effect_vibranceSaturation_desc
strings.value: Adjusts the saturation or purity of colors in the layer.

strings.name: effect_vibranceSaturation_tip
strings.value: Vibrance is a milder saturation boost that affects only midrange colors without causing over-saturation. It is best used with video or photographic images.

strings.name: effect_vignette_desc
strings.value: Darkens the edges of the layer.

strings.name: effect_voronoi_desc
strings.value: Renders procedurally-generated pattern of Voronoi cells based on randomly placed points.

strings.name: effect_warpblur_desc
strings.value: Warp Blur creates a paintbrush-like streaky distortion of a layer by blurring along gradients of a fractal noise field.

strings.name: effect_wavewarp_desc
strings.value: Distorts the layer based on a sine wave.

strings.name: effect_wipe_desc
strings.value: Masks out rectangular segments from opposite sides of the layer. Use keyframe animation to create a wipe transition.

strings.name: effect_zoomblur_desc
strings.value: Applies a radial blur to the layer, as though zooming in or out.

strings.name: effect_zoomstreaks_desc
strings.value: Creates radial streaks by scaling the layer around a point and blending together overlapping pixels.
